blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) together with Department of Agriculture, Kadiwa ni Ani at Kita, Bureau of Plant Industry, and Resto PH formally opened Locally Sourced, a weekend fair in Robinsons Malls in support of local farmers, fisherfolks, ornamental plants and fruit tree seedling vendors, and food entrepreneurs.

Locally Sourced fair recently held at the Upper Ground Level of Atrium of Robinsons Magnolia wherein you will find a wide array of beautiful plants, seeds, and gardening essentials for your home and you can also purchase country’s freshest harvest be it fruits and vegetables, seafood, coconut and dairy products, herbs, tea, and coffee at an affordable price. Special menu items are also available from participating restaurants: Monga, Mango Tree, Genki Sushi, Kureji, Scout’s Honor, and Chicken Hotpot.
